第四十三章残骨
天刚蒙蒙亮，王府后院就传来刀风破空的声音。
苏尘站在院中，手里握着残骨。晨光还没完全亮起来，院子里笼着一层薄薄的春寒，石板地上还带着昨夜的潮气。他深吸了一口气，把刀横在身前，然后动了。
劈。
刀身从头顶正中落下，沿着一条笔直的线切到腰间的位置停住——稳，没有多余的晃动。窄长的刀身在晨光里泛着沉沉的暗灰色，刃口那层冷白的光像结了霜的铁，在暗色的背景下格外分明。
苏尘收刀，侧身，换了一个方向。
撩。刀从下往上走，贴着身体的中线斜斜地拉上去，到胸口的高度停住。然后是刺——右脚跨出去一步，刀身跟着腰的转动送出去，快而干脆，刀尖在空中停了一瞬，又收了回来。
他把开山拳的基础招式融进刀里试了一下。开山拳讲究大开大合，发力在腰，落到刀上就是劈和扫最顺手。他试了几趟，发现双刃的好处——砍出去的动作不用收回来就可以直接反手拉回来接下一招，省了一个动作。
前世曹钦练了几十年的窄长刀，但那是单刃的玄镜司制式刀，握法、发力、收势都是按单刃的习惯练出来的。这把残骨两边都开了刃，他握在手里的时候，有好几次反手挥出去的时候才意识到——这把刀不需要翻腕，反手那一面也是刃。
他在心里骂了一声。
玄镜司的刀法不能用。那些招式一旦使出来，识货的人一眼就能看出来路——连苏烈那一关都过不了，更别说皇城里那些老东西。他现在只能用最基础的东西：劈、撩、刺、扫、格挡，翻来覆去地练，把前世那些肌肉记忆压下去，让这具身体重新习惯另一种握法和发力方式。
练了大概两刻钟，他身上开始发热了。春寒的凉意被一层薄汗隔开，呼吸也稳了下来。
就在他收刀换气的时候，听见了脚步声。
不轻不重，靴底踩在石板上噔噔噔的，节奏散漫——不用回头他也知道是谁。
苏烈站在回廊的台阶上，披着一件外衣，腰带随便系了一下，看样子也是刚起来没多久。他没出声，抱着手臂靠在廊柱上看了一会儿，目光落在苏尘手里的刀上，又看了看他脚下的步子，咧嘴笑了一下。
“一大早就动上家伙了？”
苏尘转过身来，叫了一声“父亲”。
苏烈从台阶上走下来，走到院子里，左右看了一眼——墙根下靠着一根晒衣裳用的长木棍，大概是下人们晾被褥用的，有小臂粗，一丈来长。他走过去顺手抽了起来，在手里掂了掂分量。
“来，让我试试你。”
苏尘愣了一下：“现在？”

“怎么，还得挑个黄道吉日？”苏烈把木棍往肩上一搭，大步走到院子中间，靴子在石板上跺了两下，找了找脚感，“刀给你了总得看看你用得怎么样。来吧，别磨叽。”
苏尘握着残骨，没动。
苏烈看他不动，也没催，把木棍从肩上放下来，随手挽了一个棍花——动作不快，但棍子在他手里像是没有重量一样，从右手换到左手，又从左手换到右手，最后停在中段，斜斜地往地上一拄。
“你用刀，我用棍。不欺负你。”
苏尘吸了一口气，握紧了刀柄。
他知道苏烈是育婴境——第六境，比他高出整整一个大境界还多。这种差距不是技巧能弥补的。但苏烈既然说要试试，那就是试试，不会真动手。
他迈出一步。
刀从下往上撩起来，走的是中路，不快不慢——第一刀是试探。苏烈看他的来势，手里的木棍往下一压，棍身横着格住了刀刃的去路。铁刃砍在木头上，发出“笃”的一声闷响，木棍上留下了一道浅浅的刀痕，但没有断。
苏尘收刀，后退了半步。
苏烈没动，棍子还横在身前，笑了一下：“再来。”
苏尘第二刀没再走中路。他侧身跨了一步，从苏烈的左手边切进去，刀身贴着木棍的侧面削过去——这是开山拳里的一记摆拳改成了刀招，借着转腰的力量把刀甩出去。苏烈把棍尾一抬，棍子的一端点在他的刀身上，轻轻一拨，就把这一刀带偏了方向。
苏尘的刀擦着木棍的边滑了过去，没有吃上力。
“有点想法。”苏烈说，“但手还没跟上。”
苏尘没接话。他稳住身形，转了半圈，从另一个方向又贴了上去。这一次他没有用大开大合的招式，而是把刀收得近了一些——刀贴着身体走，出刀的距离短了，但节奏快了。劈、刺、撩、削，一刀接一刀，中间几乎没有停顿。
苏烈没再站着不动。他往前迈了一步，手里的木棍从一个意想不到的角度扫了过来——不长不短，刚好卡在苏尘出刀的间隙里。苏尘来不及收刀，只能竖起刀身硬挡了一下。
“当——”
木棍砸在刀身上，力道沉得让苏尘的手臂震了一下。他退了半步，脚下踩实了，才没被这一棍带倒。
苏烈没有追击，把棍子收回来，在手里转了一圈：“还行，反应不错。”
苏尘甩了一下被震麻的手腕，重新握住刀柄。

Chapter 43: Remaining Bones
Just after dawn, the sound of swords piercing the sky came from the backyard of the palace.
Su Chen stood in the courtyard, holding the broken bones in his hand. The morning light has not yet completely brightened, and there is a thin layer of spring cold in the yard, and the stone floor is still covered with moisture from last night. He took a deep breath, held the knife in front of him, and then moved.
hack.
The blade dropped from the center of the head, cut along a straight line and stopped at the waist - stable, without any unnecessary shaking. The long and narrow blade glowed a deep dark gray in the morning light, and the cold white light on the blade was like frosted iron, which was particularly clear against the dark background.
Su Chen put away the knife, turned sideways, and changed the direction.
tease. The knife goes up from the bottom, and is pulled up diagonally close to the midline of the body, stopping at the height of the chest. Then came the stab - taking a step forward with his right foot, the blade of the knife was sent out with the rotation of his waist, quickly and crisply, the tip of the knife paused in the air for a moment, and then was retracted.
He integrated the basic moves of Kaishan Quan into the knife and tried it. Kaishan Quan emphasizes large openings and large closings, and the force is exerted at the waist. When it falls on the knife, it is most convenient for chopping and sweeping. He tried it a few times and discovered the advantage of double-edged swords - he could directly pull it back to receive the next move without retracting it, saving an action.
In his previous life, Cao Qin practiced a narrow long sword for decades, but it was a single-edged Xuanjingsi standard sword. The grip, force exertion, and closing posture were all practiced according to the single-edged habits. This broken bone had blades on both sides. When he held it in his hand, he realized when he swung it out with his backhand several times - this knife didn't need to be turned at the wrist, and the backhand side was also bladed.
He cursed in his mind.
Xuanjingsi's sword skills cannot be used. Once those moves are used, a discerning person can see the way out at a glance - not even Su Lie can pass, let alone those old guys in the imperial city. Now he can only use the most basic things: chopping, teasing, stabbing, sweeping, blocking, practicing over and over again, suppressing the muscle memory of his previous life, and letting this body get used to another way of holding and exerting force.
After practicing for about two-quarters of an hour, his body started to feel hot. The coolness of the spring cold was separated by a thin layer of sweat, and my breathing stabilized.
Just when he was putting away his knife and taking a breath, he heard footsteps.
Neither light nor heavy, the soles of the boots thumped on the stone slabs with a loose rhythm - he knew who it was without looking back.
Su Lie stood on the steps of the corridor, wearing a coat and casually tying his belt. It looked like he had just woken up. He didn't make a sound, folded his arms and leaned against the pillar and looked at it for a while. His eyes fell on the knife in Su Chen's hand, then he looked at the steps under his feet and grinned.
"Have you had sex so early in the morning?"
Su Chen turned around and called "Father".
Su Lie walked down the steps and walked into the yard. He glanced around - there was a long wooden stick used to dry clothes under the wall. It was probably used by the servants to dry bedding. It was as thick as a forearm and about a foot long. He walked over and started to smoke it, weighing it in his hand.
"Here, let me try you."
Su Chen was stunned for a moment: "Now?"
"Why, do you need to choose an auspicious day?" Su Lie put the wooden stick on his shoulder and strode to the middle of the yard. He stomped his boots on the stone slab twice to feel the feeling on his feet. "I gave you the knife, but I have to see how you use it. Come on, don't sharpen it."
Su Chen held the broken bones and did not move.
Seeing that he was not moving, Su Lie did not urge him. He put down the wooden stick from his shoulder and held a stick in his hand. The movement was not fast, but the stick seemed to be weightless in his hand. He changed it from his right hand to his left hand, and then from his left hand to his right hand. Finally, it stopped in the middle and tilted it to the ground.
"You use the knife, I use the stick. I won't bully you."
Su Chen took a breath and tightened his grip on the handle of the knife.
He knew that Su Lie was in the infant care realm - the sixth realm, which was a whole realm higher than him. This gap cannot be bridged by skills. But since Su Lie said he wanted to try, he would try.Not really taking action.
He takes a step.
The knife was raised from bottom to top, walking in the middle, neither fast nor slow - the first knife was a test. Seeing his coming, Su Lie pressed down the wooden stick in his hand, blocking the blade's path with the stick's body sideways. The iron blade struck the wood with a muffled sound, leaving a shallow mark on the stick, but it was not broken.
Su Chen put away the knife and took half a step back.
Su Lie didn't move. The stick was still lying in front of him. He smiled and said, "Come again."
Su Chen's second strike did not go to the middle. He took a step sideways, cut in from Su Lie's left hand, and cut the blade against the side of the stick - this was a swinging punch in Kaishan Fist that was changed into a knife move, and he used the power of turning his waist to throw the knife out. Su Lie raised the end of the stick, and the end of the stick touched the body of his sword. With a slight flick, he deflected the sword.
Su Chen's knife slid past the edge of the stick without exerting any force.
"I have some ideas," Su Lie said, "but my hands haven't caught up yet."
Su Chen didn't answer. He stabilized his body, turned half a circle, and pressed forward again from the other direction. This time he did not use wide open and close moves, but brought the knife closer - the knife moved close to the body, the distance of the knife was shorter, but the rhythm was faster. Chopping, stabbing, teasing, and whittling, one after another, with almost no pause in between.
Su Lie didn't stand still anymore. He took a step forward, and the wooden stick in his hand was swept from an unexpected angle - neither long nor short, just stuck in the gap where Su Chen took out the knife. Su Chen didn't have time to put away the knife, so he could only raise the blade to block it.
"When——"
The wooden stick hit the sword with such force that Su Chen's arm shook. He took half a step back and stepped firmly on his feet to avoid being knocked down by the stick.
Su Lie did not pursue. He took back the stick and turned it around in his hand: "It's not bad, the reaction is good."
Su Chen shook off his numb wrist and grasped the handle of the knife again.
